subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should this external PR be held for redacted live Gateway memory_search outage/recovery proof, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate based on deterministic MemoryIndexManager tests?
rationale: Repository review policy treats external PR real-behavior proof as a merge gate, but the contributor explicitly asked whether deterministic manager-level proof can be accepted instead of building a live Gateway/Ollama outage harness.

options.title: Require live Gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing fallback activation, primary recovery, and returned memory_search results before merge.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the deterministic manager regression as enough for this patch and own the remaining live-provider uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR until a maintainer-sponsored proof path or replacement fix is available.

recommendation.title: Require live Gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing fallback activation, primary recovery, and returned memory_search results before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest current-main history signal for the memory manager and fallback/provider-state lines touched by this review.
